beats.summary: Dwight attempts to put his head in a pumpkin for Halloween.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: My greased up head went into the pumpkin no problem, but …
Dwight: I mean, I could try destroying the pumpkin…

beats.summary: Dwight and Jim discuss the difficulty of removing Dwight's head from the pumpkin.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: I can't get it out. Try again!

evidence.snippet: Andy: A jitterbug. You guys look great!

beats.summary: Nellie confesses to Dwight about her anxiety medication and his potential knowledge of co-worker health issues.

evidence.snippet: Nellie: It's my pill. I have an anxiety issue and I'm not ashamed of that, But I'm not loving the idea of Dwight having that information.
Dwight: Why are you trying so hard to bury this thing, huh? What's going on Nellie? Talk to me.
